title: Sebastian and the Tide
author: Lior Whitlock
blurb: Quentin Halloran, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
